quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith feels treated like a second-unit player by Richard Jefferson
quotes.excerpt: I feel like you treat us like we're the second unit.

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: It's actually bothering me. I feel like you treat us like we're the second unit.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the difficulty of transitioning away from professional basketball
quotes.excerpt: I was not ready to be retired seven, eight years ago.

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: I fucking love being retired. I was not ready to be retired seven, eight years ago.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: How long did it take you to get the awesome once you were done?

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the personal challenge of detaching from professional sports
quotes.excerpt: Detaching from the sport fully was the best and the worst thing that ever happened.

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: Honestly, detaching from the sport fully was the best and the worst thing that ever happened. I've played the game since I was three years old. This is literally all I know. So going into a completely different stratosphere and being uncomfortable and learning how to be uncomfortable all over again, it's literally the best thing I've ever done.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Do you feel like you're doing a disservice? I have played with Grant Hill, Brandon Roy, Steve Nash, LeBron, Kyrie, and I'm probably going to put you as a top seven most talented players I've ever played with. The fact that you don't watch basketball to enjoy it and maybe teach a kid, teach somebody something?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the value of teaching basketball to the next generation
quotes.excerpt: Telling a kid where he thinks he is is not right. From our perspective is the greatest feeling.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Telling a kid where he thinks he is is not right. From our perspective is the greatest feeling because I've seen a kid who was like, yeah, I just want to, you know, maybe I want to play JV. I go, dog, you're a varsity kid. Like, if you just did ABCD three, four times a week, you'd be the man.

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: Well, love to. I know, but you're not watching it though.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith and LeBron James discuss their golf game
quotes.excerpt: I tell you one thing, we got to make a complete total 180 switch from yesterday's greens.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I tell you one thing, we got to make a complete total 180 switch from yesterday's greens.

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: Oh my god. It's not even close. It's not even close like that. That shit was so slow yesterday. Now these bitches are running.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith and LeBron James debate keeping score
quotes.excerpt: How you spend your whole life in competition and all of a sudden you talking about we not keeping score?

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: How you spend your whole life in competition and all of a sudden you talking about we not keeping score?

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: You go playing that bullshit rec league, you still keep score.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith and LeBron James discuss golf mechanics
quotes.excerpt: Start with your hips and then your arms are lagging behind your body.

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: Start with your hips and then your arms are lagging behind your body.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: You want your arms to be going through before anything, right?

text_blocks.speaker: J.R. Smith
text_blocks.text: No, your hips go through and then your arms follow.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James reflects on the 2016 championship brotherhood
quotes.excerpt: Even though 10 years has passed since we won the championship, when we link together, it's like no time is missed.
quotes.quote: Even though 10 years has passed since we won the championship, when we link together, it's like no time is missed. That's all I've ever wanted in the brotherhood, and I'm just happy and fortunate that I have that with these guys.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the unique brotherhood of the 2016 Cavs
quotes.excerpt: This group is special. We have a very unique brotherhood. We all have different personalities.
quotes.quote: This group is special. We have a very unique brotherhood. We all have different personalities. We all come from different backgrounds, but I think when you go through trials and tribulations and especially adversity and come out the other side, it makes you who you are. And when you do that together, that's what creates that true brotherhood.
